full_prompt_en: A square fantasy anime illustration shows a bald young monk standing in a dark nocturnal setting while luminous blue-white currents sweep around and behind him. The background is deep navy and teal, with shadowed vertical shapes near the lower edges and a few small bird silhouettes high in the center. Above the figure, two broad feather-like blue formations spread outward from the middle toward the upper corners. Fine curved lines fill their surfaces, making them read as a vast wing-like or flowing spiritual pattern rather than a solid wall. The young monk stands in the lower center, facing forward. A pale blue arrow-shaped marking crosses the scalp and forehead, and bright narrow eyes look directly outward beneath a stern brow. A muted green inner garment is crossed by a dark maroon wrap that drapes over one shoulder and around the torso. Most of the body remains in deep shade, so the head and upper clothing read as a strong near-black silhouette against the glowing currents. On the left, a thick ribbon of light coils into a round loop near shoulder height. It sweeps across the lower center and rises in a second broad curl along the right side, with thin trailing strands and splashes at its edges. Cool light from these moving forms illuminates the sides of the face and the nearest cloth folds, while the upper wings and dark background retain subtle blue linework. The lower ground is shadowed and only faintly visible. No readable text appears. The overall composition is ceremonial and powerful, using a centered figure, symmetrical upper spread, and restless circular light to balance stillness against motion.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形奇幻动漫插画呈现一位光头年轻修行者站在深夜环境里，蓝白色发光气流在身旁和背后扫动。背景是深海军蓝与青绿，下部边缘附近有阴影竖形，上部中央高处有几只小鸟剪影。人物上方，两道宽阔的羽毛状蓝色形体从中央向上部两角展开。细曲线填满其表面，使它们更像巨大的翅膀般或流动灵性能量图案，而非实墙。修行者站在下部中央，朝向正面。浅蓝箭头状标记越过头皮与额头，狭窄发亮的眼睛从严厉眉弓下直视外方。低饱和绿色内衣被深栗红披布交叉覆盖，布料从一侧肩膀垂下并绕过躯干。身体大部留在深影中，因此头部与上身衣物在发亮气流前读作有力的近黑剪影。左侧一道厚光带在肩高处卷成圆环，随后扫过下部中央，再沿右侧升成第二道宽阔旋涡，边缘带细尾线与溅散。运动形体的冷光照亮脸侧与最近衣褶，上部翅形和深色背景则保留细微蓝色线纹。下方地面在阴影中，只能隐约看到。没有可读文字。整体构图庄严而有力，用居中人物、近乎对称的上部展开和不安定的环形光，把静止与运动相平衡。
style_prompt_en: The fantasy anime treatment builds a near-black central silhouette inside broad, luminous blue-white arcs. Deep navy and teal form the base palette; electric cyan lines and pale highlights concentrate around the focal mass. Fine nested curves and feathered linear textures spread outward across the upper field, while thicker ribbons coil around the middle and lower areas. This contrast between hairline strokes and bold flowing bands gives the light both delicacy and force. A centered arrangement supplies stability, but irregular curls and small scattered marks keep the rhythm active. The glow behaves as a local source, illuminating only nearby edges and leaving most interior planes in cool darkness. Graphic outlines remain clear on the major shape, and softer light trails dissolve into the background. The overall effect is spiritual, intense, and kinetic, with controlled symmetry and layered light drawing the eye through a dark field.
style_prompt_zh: 这种奇幻动漫处理把近黑的中央剪影放在宽阔的蓝白发光弧线之间。深海军蓝与青绿构成基底配色，电青色线条与浅色高光集中在焦点大形周围。细密套叠曲线与羽毛状线纹向上方色域外扩，较厚光带则在中下部盘绕。发丝般细线和大胆流动色带的对照让光同时具有轻盈与力量。居中安排提供稳定性，不规则的卷曲线和散落小痕迹又让节奏活跃。光晕作为局部光源，只照亮附近边缘，让内部大多数色面保留冷暗。主要形体的图形轮廓清楚，较软的光尾则溶入背景。整体效果灵性、强烈而富动势，以受控制的对称与层叠光线引导目光穿过深色色域。
theme_en: A bald young monk encircled by luminous blue currents at night
theme_zh: 光头年轻修行者在夜色中被发亮蓝色气流环绕
name: Avatar the Last Airbender
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
